title: Politics and the state
note: B1 Oxford-gap leaf · how people get a say, then what the state is and does · 12 items · carriers via use[] · schematic intro (abstract set) · Use bank

intro.title: How a country decides
intro.body:
Most of these words have no picture, because they name a process rather than a thing: a campaign leads to an election, an election is decided by votes, and then it starts again.
The first six words are that cycle and the people in it. The last six are the country the cycle belongs to — what it is, what runs it, and what it worries about.
intro.body_cz: Abstraktní slova — pojmenovávají proces, ne věc, takže nemají obrázek.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: vote and protest are both verb and noun in English — we vote, and we count the votes; they protest, and the protest is peaceful.
intro.note_cz: vote a protest jsou v angličtině sloveso i podstatné jméno — tvar se nemění.
